name: session-harbor
description: Back up, verify, reclaim, restore, and exchange Codex sessions with fail-closed safety gates.

interface.shortDescription: Session dashboard, incremental backup, verified cleanup, restore, and sharing.
interface.longDescription: Turns a dedicated Codex task into a session-management window with backup progress, status filters, retention settings, and exact restore selectors. It backs up every local Codex session incrementally into a content-addressed vault, then optionally cleans only local sessions whose current bytes are verified and have passed separate inactivity and backup-age gates. It supports manual, weekly, and removable-drive triggers; immutable device-owned snapshots; peer session exchange; reviewed evidence-linked memory; and read-only legacy migration. SessionHarbor is an independent project by Xiaofan Wang; destructive local cleanup remains separately gated.
defaultPrompt: Use SessionHarbor as my management center and show the current read-only dashboard.
Show a dry-run plan to incrementally back up all my Codex sessions.
List sessions already removed locally and restore a selected one.
